description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Dismisses rows of the Failed backlog by the ids list_failed returned (up to the batch limit per call), like the dashboard's Dismiss. It only closes the row: the post, its status and any live booking are never touched. Each id is decided on its own; one that is not found, another brand's, already closed or being retried is skipped. `dryRun: true` reports what would close. Confirm the count with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/failed/dismiss.)
name: dismiss_failed
title: Dismiss Failed-tab rows
